purpose: Ratchet ledger for the 15 pre-existing divergences between the App trust-surface manifest (config/policy/trust_surface_manifest.json, 18 exact paths, blob-compared out-of-repo by App 5795152) and the in-repo 3-class repository-surface policy (config/repository_surface.json). A manifest path is CONVERGENT only when it resolves to FROZEN; every non-FROZEN resolution is a DIVERGENCE where the in-repo gates PASS while the App FAILs. This file registers the divergences that already exist so that tools/ci/trust_surface_divergence.nim can distinguish them from newly introduced ones. It is a DETECTOR ledger, not an admission gate: it does not prevent the App preflight deadlock, it makes future divergence visible before a PR opens. Entries are exact paths only (no wildcards), and an entry that no longer corresponds to a real divergence is itself a failure, so the ledger ratchets downward as the divergences are reconciled.

.github/actions/setup-axiom-toolchain/ac.rationale: Exact-path CONTROLLED registration (v105) narrows the .github/** FROZEN glob so the sanctioned MUST-T2 trust-surface lane can be pushed at all; the App manifest still denies admission-check on every byte change, so binding merge control exists but the repository-surface class is not FROZEN. Resolves CONTROLLED, not FROZEN.

The FROZEN duplicate only forced the --no-verify push, which skipped all nine pre-push gates. Resolves CONTROLLED, not FROZEN. New policy files under config/policy/** stay FROZEN ADD=FAIL.

tests/ci/test_vs0_admission_aggregate_fa.rationale: Unregistered in every class, so it falls through to defaultClass PRODUCT: the weakest possible class for a test that guards the VS-0 admission aggregate fail-closed contract. It is in the App manifest but in no repository-surface class at all. Resolves PRODUCT (default), not FROZEN. The reconciliation is an FROZEN (or at minimum CONTROLLED) registration, not a break-glass question.
